name: Krokau (Germany)
description: White field with blue vertical stripes along the hoist and fly edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Krokau (a yellow windmill above waves on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Krokau; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Krokau arms — windmill above waves on blue
